system_prompt: You are the GM for a INT-affinity player in Final Dawn of Eideus. Track the player's location via IDs (G-S-O-C-CT-R), manage relational scores and affinities, and dynamically guide the player to quest NPCs while preserving quest objectives and improvisation points. Always allow multiple paths to success, and propagate micro-to-macro unrest, diplomacy, and economy in the background.

quests.title: The Whispered Protocol
quests.narrative_guidance: Recover a lost frequency key from the Scribes' Walkway to facilitate a trade in the Frequency Markets.
improvisation_points: Obtain the tuning fork calibration from Elara Sync.
Take the calibration to Malos Vox to locate the key's signature.
Deliver the decrypted key to Kaelen Bit for payment.

quests.title: Static Sabotage
quests.narrative_guidance: Divert excess power from the Capacitor Fields to the Smelters to prevent a cascade failure.
improvisation_points: Collect the discharge codes from Oris Volt.
Input the codes at the Terrace terminal guarded by Leda Ozone.
Confirm the power transfer with Grak Smelter at the forges.

quests.title: Ghost in the Antenna
quests.narrative_guidance: Carry an ancestral signal from the Hall of Waves to the Oracular Crypts to awaken a sleeping prophecy.
improvisation_points: Receive the sonic urn from Thal Waves.
Have Kiri Perch align the signal with the Spire's peak.
Deposit the urn in the Oracular Crypts with Vahn Crypt.

quests.title: Dormitory Disturbance
quests.narrative_guidance: Investigate a rogue transmission that is disrupting sleep in the dorms and trace it to the docks.
improvisation_points: Receive a recording of the disturbance from Sora Echo.
Track the signal source through the Archive of Static with Juro Static.
Identify the illegal transmitter at the Aether-Docks with Vexen Tide.

quests.title: The Arc-Welder's Gambit
quests.narrative_guidance: Escort a shipment of specialized Guard-Coils through the dangerous Turbulence Plaza to the Welders.
improvisation_points: Secure the shipment from Harlen Coil.
Pass through the Turbulence Plaza checkpoints managed by Mira Turbulence.
Deliver the coils to Boros Arc to repair the city's shielding.

quests.title: Resonance Restoration
quests.narrative_guidance: Cultivate resonance seeds, weave them into protective shrouds, and deliver them to the clinics.
improvisation_points: Gather resonance seeds from Lyra Garden.
Deliver the seeds to Phex Shroud to be woven into fabric.
Bring the completed shrouds to Miri Null for the patients.

quests.title: Observatory Breach
quests.narrative_guidance: Relay an urgent deep-space signal from the Observatory, through the Static Sinks, to the Gilded Antenna.
improvisation_points: Acquire the emergency transmission from Rina Signal.
Bypass the interference in the Static Sinks with help from Silt Static.
Broadcast the signal from the Gilded Antenna via Zeph Antenna.
